evidence_scope: Visual observation only; no survival rate, tracking proxy, internal score, or official score adjudication.

records.observation: Multiple robots changed position on flat terrain in the commanded forward direction. No clearly prone body posture was visible in sampled frames from 0.2 to 9.8 seconds.
records.limitations: Exact velocity tracking, survival of all 32 environments, and transient events between sampled frames were not adjudicated.

records.observation: Multiple robots displayed locomotion and upright gait on flat terrain. No clearly prone posture was visible in sampled frames from 0.2 to 9.8 seconds.
records.limitations: Camera perspective and arrows do not permit quantitative diagonal-left tracking or survival adjudication for every environment.

records.observation: Robots moved over visibly rough terrain. No clearly prone body posture was visible in frames sampled every 0.5 seconds from 0.5 to 9.5 seconds.
records.limitations: Only the visible robots can be observed. Rough-terrain completion, tracking accuracy, and all 32 environment states were not adjudicated.

records.observation: Stair structures and robots moving on nearby flat ground were visible, but sampled frames from 0.5 to 9.5 seconds did not show a robot contacting and climbing the stair steps. The visible robots were not clearly prone.
records.limitations: This video cannot establish successful or failed 15 cm stair ascent. Robots appear to remain in flat corridors between stair structures, and other environments may be outside the camera view.
